title: Surreal Cosmic Sea Castle
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a black gothic castle with glowing eyes and a purple portal, floating on a swirling cosmic sea under a spiral sky with a sun, moon, and stars. In the foreground on a cracked stone platform, four women in bright pink and blue outfits pose with futuristic guns, a glowing blue hammer, and smartphones, while two wooden sailboats with spiral sails drift nearby.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene on a cosmic ocean with swirling yellow patterns, featuring a large menacing black gothic castle with glowing white eyes, horns, and a bright purple portal doorway. In the foreground on cracked dark stone, four stylized women in bright pink and blue futuristic outfits pose playfully with sci-fi guns, a glowing blue hammer, and smartphones. Two wooden sailboats with pink and green spiral sails float on the water. The sky is a swirling vortex of orange, purple and yellow with a bright sun and green crescent moon. Psychedelic, vibrant, detailed digital art.
